name: 79934 · El Paso, TX
findings: ZIP 79934 (El Paso) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 79934 (El Paso) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 79934 (El Paso) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 28% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.
